com.saicone.ezlib

Class EzlibLoader

  • java.lang.Object
    • com.saicone.ezlib.EzlibLoader

  • public class EzlibLoader
extends java.lang.Object
    EzlibLoader class to load & apply all the needed dependencies from files into class path using Ezlib.
